standard.description: Normal account. The default for every scenario that is not about a user's quirks.

lockedOut.description: Rejected at login with 'Sorry, this user has been locked out.'

problem.description: Logs in, then renders broken images and misbehaving form fields.

performanceGlitch.description: Logs in with a deliberate multi-second delay. Useful for proving waits are not fixed sleeps.

error.description: Logs in, then fails partway through checkout.

visual.description: Logs in with deliberate visual defects. Reserved for visual-regression work.

invalid.description: Not a real account. Drives the invalid-credentials scenario.
